thesis_summary.thesis: Axon Enterprise (NASDAQ: AXON) sells an integrated public-safety technology platform: TASER less-lethal devices, body cameras and sensors, Axon Evidence cloud storage, dispatch and real-time operations software (including Fusus), and counter-drone capabilities (Dedrone). **[Fact]** FY2025 revenue was **$2.78 billion** and net income was **$124.7 million**. **[Fact]** Annual recurring revenue totaled **$1.3 billion** as of December 31, 2025. **[Fact]** FY2025 operating cash flow was **$211.3 million** and capital spending was **$136.3 million**, leaving **$75.1 million** of normalized owner earnings (**$0.93 per share**). **[Inference]** Axon is a compounder-shaped platform with strong recurring mix, but acquisition debt and heavy reinvestment mean owner cash today is tiny relative to revenue and market capitalization.
thesis_summary.why_market_wrong: The market may be pricing **software recurring revenue and AI-enabled public-safety optionality** while underweighting **$1.73 billion of long-term debt**, **capital spending that consumed nearly two-thirds of operating cash flow in FY2025**, and **insider selling** (roughly **$251 million** net sales versus **$1 million** net buys over the past year per insider panel). **[Inference]** At **$607.20**, the stock embeds decades of growth in owner cash that filings do not yet support; our reverse check implies more than **40%** perpetual owner-cash growth at an 18-times exit multiple just to justify today's price.
